full_page.content:
1946, August 16
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey O.F.M. Cap.
Blessed be God!
August 16th, 1946
God bless you Bernice M. Schumacher you and yours.
I am glad you are feeling improved. Keep up the improvement and don't give way to worry or discour- agement. That never pays. If we could only learn to appreciate the holy faith and the innumerable blessings flowing from it and the blessings other- wise surrounding us; We could never have time to worry about anything - except that we're so little appreciative.
P.S. Congratulations to your Husband, H.
.Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
Original in possession of: Bernice M. Schumacher 42079 Toddmark Lane Mt. Clements, Mi. 48044
